_about: Every clue, key and locked door in the game. unreal/place_clues.py puts them in the level as BP_Examinable actors. Coordinates are Unreal cm (z = height of the surface the thing sits on). Texts are final (from the story workbook, 2026-11-16). Clues whose props aren't built yet live in new_prop_texts (place_clues.py ignores that block); move each into clues with its 'at' once its prop exists.

_fields.title / body: what the reading screen shows (no body = no reading screen)
_fields.journal: line added to the Tab journal the first time
_fields.gives_key / needs_key: key name; needs_key locks it until you have that key
_fields.objective: new objective line after using it
_fields.paper: the sheet the reading screen shows it on: stationery, notebook, typed, ledger, scrap (tools/make_papers.py), or a picture with its words drawn in (use hand none): key_office, key_gate, key_boathouse (tools/make_keys.py), register (tools/make_guest_book.py)
_fields.hand: whose writing the reading screen uses: cas = Rock Salt, wrong = Zeyada, print = typed; none = Bug's Ink Free
_fields.open_angle: how far a door swings (default 95; negative swings the other way)
_fields.shape: paper, map_ground, key, book, door or room_door (see SHAPES in place_clues.py)
_fields.body2 / hand2 / paper2: a second sheet: the reading screen shows both side by side (body on the left, body2 on the right)
_fields.also: a second flat prop beside the clue (card = export/keycard_<card>.png; dx, dy = cm along the clue's own axes; yaw = extra turn); the aim box covers both

start_objective: There's something on the ground by the car. I should see what that is.

room104.next: I have her office key. Whatever she found, it started in the office.

office.next: A key marked GATE. The trail behind the motel starts at that gate.

shack.next: Something is very wrong. This place... it's making me see things. The boathouse is circled on her map. Whatever this is, it ends at the lake.

game_text.opening:
October 2002.

It's been a year since Cas stopped answering my calls. Other than me, she has no one to even care to look for her. Not since her mom went missing.

Then last week a postcard came. Marrow Falls Motel on the front. On the back, one line...

i miss you bug
game_text.ending_page:
you came, bug

now we can be together
game_text.ending_place: the end of the dock (a red lantern on the last planks)
game_text.ending_screen: cut to black right away (after Bug's line and the rattle behind you)
game_text.wrong_hand_font: fonts/Zeyada.ttf (postcard, later shack pages, boathouse note, last page)
game_text.cas_hand_font: fonts/RockSalt-Regular.ttf (map, letter, wall notes, shack notebook)

new_prop_texts._about: Final texts for clues whose props aren't built yet. place_clues.py ignores this block.

missing_poster_bug.where: Payphone in the lot, final shot a year later (look only). Car pulling in: unseen.
missing_poster_bug.body:
MISSING

(Bug's photo-booth silhouette)

Last seen: Marrow Falls Motel, October 2002
Brunette, 5'4", blue eyes, 21 years old

If you have any information please call 555-0117

clues.title: A hand-drawn map
clues.journal: This is Cas's handwriting. It looks like she made a map of this place.
clues.objective: Cas marked room 104 on her map. I should check her room.

clues.title: A letter on the bed
clues.body:
Mom,

I'm in 104, the same room you stayed in. The man working the front desk of the office wouldn't even look at me when I asked for 104.

I found your name in their register book. They kept it all these years, almost like they knew someone would come looking.

I took the office key off the board. I'm going to find out what they wrote about you.

I haven't told anyone I'm here. Not even Bug.

- C
clues.journal: A letter Cas wrote to her mom and never sent. Her mom stayed in this same room. She never told me any of this.
clues.objective: She never told me any of this. What else did she leave in here?

clues.title: Office key
clues.body:
A brass key on a cracked plastic tag.

PROPERTY OF MARROW FALLS MOTEL
OFFICE - DO NOT REMOVE FROM PREMISES
clues.journal: Found the office key on the dresser next to the TV.
clues.objective: The office key. She must have taken it. I want to look around her room first.

clues.locked_text: It's locked. There has to be a key somewhere.
clues.objective: Nobody's here. I should look around before someone comes back.

clues.title: Guest register
clues.body:
MARROW FALLS MOTEL - GUEST REGISTER

Oct 14 1997 - D. Hollis - Room 102 - 2 nights
Oct 15 1997 - The Carvers (2) - Room 106 - 1 night
Oct 17 1997 - Eileen Byrne - Room 104 - 1 night
Oct 18 1997 -
Oct 19 1997 -
Oct 20 1997 -

Below her name, in pencil, in a different hand:

104 - kept.
clues.journal: Her mom's name is in the motel's register: Eileen Byrne, October 17, 1997, Room 104. Someone wrote 'kept' under it. Nobody checked in after her.
clues.objective: Her mom's name. October 1997. Room 104. Someone wrote 'kept' under it. What could that mean? There might be more in this office.

clues.title: Back gate key
clues.body:
A new key on a red tag, lying on the office desk. Someone wrote on the tag:

PROPERTY OF MARROW FALLS MOTEL - GATE.
clues.journal: Found a key marked GATE in the back room, next to the researchers' folder. The trail behind the motel starts at a locked gate.
clues.objective: A key marked GATE. Before I go, I want to see what else is in this office.

clues.locked_text: A new chain and padlock. Someone wants this kept shut.
clues.objective: Her map marks a hunter's shack along the trail. She must have stopped there.

clues.title: Boathouse key
clues.body: A small new key on a loop of fishing line, lying on Cas's lake map. Someone drew a circle around the boathouse.
clues.journal: Found a new key on Cas's map in the hunter's shack. The boathouse is circled.
clues.objective: A key, and the boathouse circled. What could she have been looking for there?

clues.locked_text: Padlocked. The lock is new, everything else here is rotting.
clues.objective: Someone's been in here recently. I should look around.

clues.title: A folder on the bed
clues.body:
THE TRIALS OF BLACK HOLLOW LAKE

Aug 3 1974 - Trying to find the source of the sound at the deepest part of the lake and failed again. The line goes down and keeps going.

Aug 9 1974 - There's a rattling heard from the water every night now. It stops when we stop, but it starts again as soon as we move.

Aug 21 1974 - Lanterns along the shore seem to keep it quiet. Red works best.

Oct 17 1974 - Freedman walked into the water. We found his boots on the dock. In the morning a boy came out of the woods who went missing in 1952. He hasn't aged.

One goes in. Something comes back out.

We can't continue the trials, we've lost too much. The motel will stay open. Someone has to keep the lanterns lit.
clues.journal: A folder of the researchers' notes from 1974, left on the bed in the back room. One goes in. Something comes back out.
clues.objective: One goes in, something comes back. Cas read this. The study clearly said 'something' comes back, but she wanted to believe it could be her mom.

clues.title: Notes on the cot
clues.body:
Night 3. I can't stay in the motel anymore. They watch me there.

The rattle comes every night now. It stops when I stop. So I don't stop.

I heard her calling from the water. She said my name the way she used to, like she did when I was eight.

The log said one goes in, one comes back. I could bring her back.
clues.body2:
she's not sleeping anymore

bug will come. bug always comes

i left bug a map

- cas
clues.journal: Cas camped out at the hunter's shack. Her notebook says she heard her mom calling from the water. The page beside it is signed cas, but it's not her handwriting. It's the same writing as the postcard.
clues.objective: She read the log wrong. It said something comes back out, not someone. And that page isn't her handwriting. It's the same writing as the postcard. Something is very wrong.

clues.title: A note by her boots
clues.body:
the lanterns are lit for you, bug

don't worry, it won't be much longer now
clues.journal: Her boots by the water door, set side by side. A note beside them: it won't be much longer now.
clues.objective: Those are Cas's boots. Not much longer... the rattling is getting louder... everything is bending around me... The lanterns on the dock are all lit. Something's at the end of it.

clues.locked_text: A page under the lantern. Not yet. I need to know what happened to her first.
clues.body:
you came, bug

now we can be together

clues.title: Cas's wall
clues.journal: A photo-booth strip of Cas and me on her wall. I remember the day we took these. I've kept my copy on me ever since it came out of the photo booth.
clues.objective: This is where her mom went missing. She never told me she was looking for her. What else is in here?
